entries.description: Deliver and commission a silicon-spin-qubit testbed system at NQCC under the UKRI £30M competition
entries.note: Programme target was deployment by March 2025; installation announced September 2025. 'Commissioned/operational' confirmation pending — achieved_late records delivery, not operational validation.

entries.description: Advance from QBI Stage A to Stage B
entries.note: A selection event (claim class selection), recorded as a program milestone, not technical evidence.

entries.description: Advance to US2QC final phase / QBI Stage C validation
entries.note: Deepest stage reached by any company; still an evaluation in progress.

entries.description: Break ground on Brisbane and Chicago Quantum Compute Centers
entries.note: Announced intent; construction status not independently verified in Genesis — open past its promised date marks it for review.

entries.description: Demonstrate two-qubit gates on foundry-fabricated MOS arrays — the step that converts 'manufacturable qubits' into a manufacturable computer
entries.note: Exchange control (the gate basis) was demonstrated per company research feed; a measured two-qubit gate fidelity on the foundry process is the next decisive observation.
